contentPattern.structure: 1 column. Row 1 = background photo (image alone in its cell). Row 2 = logo image (own paragraph), heading (authored level kept; H1 on this page) with optional <strong> accent phrase, CTA link(s); optional small image-link badge pinned top-right.
contentPattern.notes: Author heading once (source repeats it 3x for breakpoints). Promote to H1 (source uses H2; page has no H1). Windows 11 badge is minor; optional small image link in content cell or drop.
